card.name: "Other" in comparisons with related drugs
card.fires_on: The word "other" (or "of") right after "that of the", "relative to" or "lacks ... of", where one item is compared with the rest of its group. Also fires on a few partial drug or place names.

modes.label: Comparison to other members
modes.description: "other" after "than/of/to the" when a drug is compared with others of its class.
modes.example: Nitrofurantoin lacks the broader tissue distribution of<< other>> therapeutic agents approved for urinary tract infections.

modes.label: Inside drug or place names
modes.description: Endings of long names such as -afil or -imus, or a mountain name.
modes.example: or varden<<afil>> at a single dose not exceeding 2
